package fixture

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json/jsontext"
	"encoding/json/v2"
	"testing"
)

func TestRoundTrip(t *testing.T) {
	v, err := NewMessageText(MessageText{Text: "hello"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	b, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(b) != "{\"text\":\"hello\",\"kind\":\"text\"}" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected wire value: %s", b)
	}
	text, ok := v.AsText()
	if !ok || text.Text != "hello" {
		t.Fatal("failed to narrow text")
	}
	if _, ok := v.AsCustom(); ok {
		t.Fatal("matched wrong discriminator")
	}
	for _, bad := range []string{"null", "{}", "{\"kind\":\"text\"}", "{\"kind\":\"text\",\"text\":42}"} {
		value, err := ParseMessage([]byte(bad))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, ok := value.AsText(); ok {
			t.Fatalf("matched invalid shape %s", bad)
		}
	}
	raw := []byte("{\"kind\":\"future\",\"vendor\":{\"x\":9007199254740993}}")
	future, err := ParseMessage(raw)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw[0] = '['
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(future)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !bytes.Contains(encoded, []byte("9007199254740993")) {
		t.Fatalf("lost precision: %s", encoded)
	}
	copy := future.RawJSON()
	copy[0] = '['
	if future.RawJSON()[0] != '{' {
		t.Fatal("raw storage leaked")
	}
	if _, err := ParseMessage([]byte("{\"kind\":\"text\",\"kind\":\"custom\"}")); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted duplicate object member")
	}
	if _, err := ParseMessage([]byte{'"', 0xff, '"'}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted invalid UTF-8")
	}
	var custom MessageCustom
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte("{\"kind\":\"custom\",\"vendor\":true}"), &custom); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	custom.AdditionalProperties["kind"] = jsontext.Value("\"wrong\"")
	if _, err := json.Marshal(custom); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("accepted a duplicate extension key")
	}
	delete(custom.AdditionalProperties, "kind")
	b, err = json.Marshal(custom)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var fields map[string]jsontext.Value
	if err = json.Unmarshal(b, &fields); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(fields["kind"]) != "\"custom\"" || string(fields["vendor"]) != "true" {
		t.Fatalf("lost custom fields: %s", b)
	}
	enabled := false
	empty := []string{}
	label := ""
	b, err = json.Marshal(Options{Enabled: &enabled, Tags: &empty, Label: &label})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(b) != "{\"enabled\":false,\"count\":null,\"tags\":[],\"label\":\"\"}" {
		t.Fatalf("lost optional/nullable fields: %s", b)
	}
}

func TestUnionOwnershipAndStreams(t *testing.T) {
	original, err := ParseMessage([]byte(`{"kind":"text","text":"first"}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	copied := original
	if err := copied.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{"kind":"text","text":"other"}`)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	first, ok := original.AsText()
	if !ok || first.Text != "first" {
		t.Fatal("decoding a copy changed the original")
	}
	encoded, err := original.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	encoded[0] = '['
	if original.RawJSON()[0] != '{' {
		t.Fatal("MarshalJSON exposed mutable storage")
	}
	before := copied.RawJSON()
	if err := copied.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(`{`)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid input accepted")
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(before, copied.RawJSON()) {
		t.Fatal("failed decode mutated receiver")
	}
	dec := jsontext.NewDecoder(bytes.NewBufferString(`{"kind":"text","text":"first"} {"kind":"text","text":"other"}`))
	var a, b Message
	if err := json.UnmarshalDecode(dec, &a); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.UnmarshalDecode(dec, &b); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	first, ok = a.AsText()
	if !ok || first.Text != "first" {
		t.Fatal("decoder buffer was retained")
	}
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := json.MarshalEncode(jsontext.NewEncoder(&out), &a); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := ParseMessage(out.Bytes()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	// Decoder options must reach the generated streaming method.
	duplicate := []byte(`{"kind":"text","kind":"custom"}`)
	if err := json.Unmarshal(duplicate, &a, jsontext.AllowDuplicateNames(true)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func TestNarrowingNullAndLiterals(t *testing.T) {
	if _, err := NewLiteralChoiceVariant1("no"); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("constructor accepted wrong literal")
	}
	if _, err := NewNullableChoiceVariant2(jsontext.Value(`42`)); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("null constructor accepted number")
	}
	bad, err := ParseMessage([]byte(`{"kind":"text","text":null}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, ok := bad.AsText(); ok {
		t.Fatal("null matched required string")
	}
	for _, source := range []string{`"no"`, `null`, `42`} {
		v, err := ParseLiteralChoice([]byte(source))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, ok := v.AsVariant1(); ok {
			t.Fatalf("%s matched literal yes", source)
		}
	}
	yes, err := ParseLiteralChoice([]byte(`"yes"`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if value, ok := yes.AsVariant1(); !ok || value != "yes" {
		t.Fatal("literal did not match")
	}
	var nullable NullableChoice
	if err := nullable.UnmarshalJSON([]byte(" \n null \t")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, ok := nullable.AsVariant2(); !ok {
		t.Fatal("whitespace affected null classification")
	}
	if _, ok := nullable.AsVariant1(); ok {
		t.Fatal("null matched string")
	}
	v, err := ParseWithNullable([]byte(`{"value":null}`))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, ok := v.AsVariant1(); !ok {
		t.Fatal("nullable required field was rejected")
	}
}

func TestNativeExtensionFields(t *testing.T) {
	var v Extras
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"fixed":1,"a":2,"z":3}`), &v); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if v.AdditionalProperties["a"] != 2 {
		t.Fatal("typed index signature was lost")
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{"fixed":1,"a":"wrong"}`), &v); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("invalid extension value accepted")
	}
	custom := MessageCustom{Kind: "custom", AdditionalProperties: map[string]jsontext.Value{"z": []byte("1"), "a": []byte("2")}}
	b, err := json.Marshal(custom, json.Deterministic(true))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if string(b) != `{"kind":"custom","a":2,"z":1}` {
		t.Fatalf("options did not propagate to extensions: %s", b)
	}
}
